verdict.rationale: Fellow's marketing claims configurable, organization-wide retention policies, including zero-day retention. The Enterprise Super Admin API documents deleting data across the workspace to erase third-party data under privacy regulations, and a delete-note endpoint is restricted to super admins. However, the retention claim is homepage-level only, and on-demand deletion is shown only through the API. missing for 10: documentation of schedule-based auto-deletion settings (periods, scope covering transcripts and recordings specifically), confirmation that deletion is permanent or irrecoverable, an admin-UI erase path, explicit recording/transcript delete endpoints, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an IT admin, I can set retention policies — auto-delete transcripts and recordings on a schedule — and permanently erase data on demand

citations.quote: Set configurable retention policies, including zero-day retention, so data is handled according to your organization’s requirements.
Set organization-wide policies for how meetings are recorded, accessed, and retained

Fellow’s Super Admin API lets designated Enterprise‑plan administrators retrieve, export, and delete data across the entire workspace, making it simple to back up notes and transcripts for legal purposes and to erase third‑party data in line with privacy regulations.
Only users with super admin privileges can delete notes through the API.
